html:
<button class="install-btn" type="button" aria-label="Установить">
  <svg class="install-btn__svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
    <defs>
      <mask id="install-mask">
        <circle
          class="install-btn__mask-circle"
          cx="50"
          cy="50"
          r="42"
          stroke-dasharray="39.2 13.6"
          stroke-linecap="round"
        ></circle>
      </mask>
    </defs>

    <circle
      class="install-btn__track"
      cx="50"
      cy="50"
      r="42"
      stroke-dasharray="39.2 13.6"
      stroke-linecap="round"
    ></circle>

    <circle
      class="install-btn__fill"
      cx="50"
      cy="50"
      r="42"
      mask="url(#install-mask)"
    ></circle>
  </svg>

  <svg
    class="install-btn__icon"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2.2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
  >
    <path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"></path>
    <polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"></polyline>
    <line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"></line>
  </svg>
</button>
